details: Every time the game is booted up, there is a problem with my VRC+ avatar folders, as they are having problems being accessed, before the 50 folder limit update and afterwards. The problem is that the game upon opening, only the Beta is having this problem, believes that my VRC+ subscription has expired, despite it not expiring until next May. The avatars are also unaccessible from the launch pad until I go onto the VRC+ Subscription tab on the large in-game menu, open it up, and exiting the subscription screen. After this, all 6 avatar folders are accessible, though they still have the 25 count limit from the launch pad. The avatars are still inaccessible from the large avatar menu despite this, and they are only accessible from the launch pad wings. I really hope this gets fixed soon, as I’m tired of going through this process every singe day. Thank you for your time.
title: Avatar accessibility problem
